note: Every organisation, place, person, figure and sentence in this file is invented. Hosts use the reserved .example top-level domain. Nothing here is, or is derived from, a real source.

cases.family: Repeated releases mistaken for independent corroboration
cases.title: One release, syndicated through a wire
cases.rationale: The wire copy and the newsroom original are one origin. Two copies of one statement are not two sources, so the signal stays single-origin and, graded `possible`, opens no opportunity.

cases.family: Repeated releases mistaken for independent corroboration
cases.title: CONTROL: two genuinely independent origins
cases.rationale: A company statement and a state authority's own record of the same plan are two origins. The existing promotion rule (two independent sources) must keep working.

cases.family: Repeated releases mistaken for independent corroboration
cases.title: One project in an 8-K and again in a 10-Q three months later
cases.rationale: The same project reported in two months is ONE project: one signal and one opportunity. The month of the publication date must not be part of a project's identity.

documents.text: Brindlemoor Foods will build a new 280,000 square foot manufacturing plant in Carrow Ridge, Tennessee, a $210 million investment that will create 240 jobs.

cases.family: Repeated releases mistaken for independent corroboration
cases.title: One project described with two different asset nouns
cases.rationale: The same plant called a "plant" in one document and a "facility" in another is one project. The matched asset noun must not be part of a project's identity.
